project_context.theme: Dark navy base (#0f172a) with high-contrast light accents. Highly trust-inspiring, modern, and elite.
project_context.primary_goal: Drive phone calls and WhatsApp messages for intercity partial load logistics.
project_context.address: Yenidoğan, Ertuğrul Gazi Cd No:17, 38280 Talas/Kayseri

typography.logo: CSS-based text logo. Use 'Cabinet Grotesk', mixing font weights: 'kayseri' in font-black and 'parsiyel' in font-light. No generic fonts like Inter.
typography.rules: Headings must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tighter). Overlines must be uppercase with wide spacing (tracking-[0.2em]). Line height must be tight for headers (leading-none).

colors.archetype: The Performance Pro mixed with Swiss Brutalist.
colors.rules: Never use pure #000000. Use dark navy (#0f172a / slate-900) as the foundation. Ensure APCA contrast compliance for all text.

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise/grain overlays to break the digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use Crystal Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/60 border-white/10) for sticky header and floating UI elements.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px crisp solid borders for cards and sections. Use nested radii correctly.

grids_and_layouts.grid_system: Bento Grid Protocol (Mode A: The Tetris Grid). Asymmetrical, high visual tension. Avoid standard centered container layouts.
grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. Use p-8, p-16, p-24. Containers with borders must have internal padding.
grids_and_layouts.alignment: Optical alignment over geometrical. Left-align text blocks. Never center everything.

patterns.scroll: Lenis smooth momentum scrolling is mandatory.
patterns.hero: Kinetic masked line-by-line reveal for the main H1.
patterns.interactions: Hover states must have micro-interactions (e.g., slight lift -translate-y-1, color shift).
patterns.marquee: Slow, elegant editorial ribbon for trust keywords.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for body text. Use hover states that explicitly change text color.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links) MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

component_styling.buttons: Sharp edges or subtle rounding (max 8px). High contrast. Hover states should lighten the hue.
component_styling.cards: Flat solid background or subtle glassmorphism with 1px border. Do not overuse soft drop shadows.
component_styling.header: Sticky nav (z-50). Must have a background (glassmorphism), never completely transparent.
component_styling.whatsapp_fab: Fixed bottom-right corner, vibrant WhatsApp green or brand accent, with a pulsing ring animation.

sections_instructions.hero: Large kinetic hero. Background image heavily darkened (bg-slate-950/70) so text is 100% readable. H1: 'Kayseri Şehirler Arası Parça Yük Taşıma'. Prominent Phone CTA and WhatsApp CTA.
sections_instructions.marquee: Infinite scrolling marquee displaying trust signals (e.g., 'GÜVENLİ TESLİMAT • SİGORTALI TAŞIMACILIK • ZAMANINDA TESLİM').
sections_instructions.what_we_do: Grid of 3-4 clipped photography cards focusing on partial load transport. Short, punchy text. Asymmetrical layout.
sections_instructions.manifesto: Numbered trust chapters (e.g., 01. Güven, 02. Hız). Use overlapping typography and negative space.
sections_instructions.contact: Footer/Contact section combining persuasive text, prominent phone number (0533 127 55 00), and a modern styled Google Maps iframe for the address.

hero_bg.description: Large truck on highway at dusk. Perfect for dramatic hero background.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Install required libraries: framer-motion, lucide-react, @studio-freight/react-lenis (or lenis), react-fast-marquee.
Ensure the application strictly operates in Dark Mode to match the slate-900 / navy aesthetic.
Do NOT apply universal transitions (transition: all). Target specific properties.
Do NOT center align the app container in CSS. Remove default App.css text-align: center.
All interactive components MUST feature a data-testid attribute.
Avoid Shadcn defaults where they look generic; heavily customize them using Tailwind to match the brutalist/premium aesthetic.
Never use generic placeholder images. Use the provided image URLs.
No price calculators, no FAQ, no customer reviews, no service-area lists as per strict exclusions.
